name: wop-platform/wop-php-sdk
description: WOP merchant PHP SDK: protocol core (sign/digest/digital envelope) + pluggable HTTP transport adapters

suggest.ext-openssl: L2 envelope bulk encryption (AES-256-GCM) requires the OpenSSL extension
suggest.ext-curl: CurlTransport (default HTTP adapter) requires the cURL extension
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: GuzzleTransport peer adapter (kept out of core dependencies)
